insights.headline: Meta CAPI token missing on Alpha Breast Lift
insights.prose: Meta CAPI token missing on Alpha Breast Lift — paste your Meta Conversions API access token into Funnel Settings → Tracking → Meta Pixel → CAPI token so server-side purchases reach Meta. Until then the browser pixel is the only rail, and it is the one ad blockers stop.

insights.headline: Product → Checkout on Alpha Breast Lift fell to 3.3%
insights.prose: Step-through from Product → Checkout on Alpha Breast Lift dropped to 3.3% on 2026-08-09 vs a 50.0% 28-day average (60 visitors on Product today). This build records page VIEWS, not form submits, so this is a visitor through-rate between consecutive steps — not a submit rate.

leak_scan_cap.note: row ceiling on the step-ledger scan — matches the reference _BUCKET_SCAN_CAP.
